gameLocalization.note: Guide spelling variants are resolved against paired Canto VII records. The guide alias for Shimmering is matched to SwirlingBlood by its Shield persistence, 5 Bleed retaliation, and 3 Fragile effects. The guide spellings for Hardblood and Blood Armor both refer to the localized BloodArmor status, Hardblood. Original guide conditions and numeric values are retained.

stageName.text: The Tale of the Great Fixer Who Sought the Dream: Final Battle

statNote.text: Enemy levels are base values for the Canto VII dungeon versions. Both main-body forms' Defense and skill levels account for Withered and the Golden Bough's Forced Arbitration, totaling −40. Adds show values before individual modifiers. Mirror Dungeon-only damage reductions are excluded.

lead.text: A long encounter: clear adds during the Ferris Wheel phase, then manage Bleed and restraints in the humanoid phase. Have allies defeat Coagulated Dreams to turn them into support and prepare for the big attacks.

listLead.text: A long fight: handle adds in the first form, then manage Bleed and restraints in the second. Have an ally defeat the crystallized dream to turn it into support and prepare for major attacks.

priorities.0.text: Do not try to damage the Ferris Wheel directly. Handle Gondolas and self-destructing adds.

priorities.1.text: Aim to win against Unbreakable attacks too, adjusting action order for Sinners with accumulated Bleed.

priorities.2.text: Have allies quickly destroy Spears to free Sinners. Defeat Coagulated Dreams with allies too, gaining support for the big attack.

troubleshooting.0.symptom.text: The Ferris Wheel loses no HP

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: This phase is not about directly damaging the main body. Defeat Gondolas to reduce The Endless Wheel. Equip Defense Skills on everyone to handle the summoning area attacks.

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: Unbreakable attacks and Bleed both remain. Early in the humanoid phase especially, check whether heavily Bleeding Sinners can act before receiving more Bleed. Use reserves to recover too.

troubleshooting.2.symptom.text: An ally is trapped in a Spear

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: Destroy the Impaling Spear quickly with allied attacks. Leaving it alone or letting the boss kill it causes more harm. Removing the Spear releases its corresponding ally next turn.

troubleshooting.3.symptom.text: HP recovers or the turn ends after dealing damage

troubleshooting.3.advice.text: HP-based phase transitions prevent clearing everything in a single burst. Check the enemy's next skill and remaining Dreams and Spears, then advance the mechanics.

units.0.notes.0.text: Base Lv.90, but starts with a total −40 to Offense and Defense Levels. Defense Level 92 becomes 52 after modifiers. Recommended development target: Lv.50.

units.0.notes.1.text: Patterns change or turns end forcibly near 75%, 60%, 40%, and 20% HP. Exact boundaries have some uncertainty, so do not plan progression using a fixed damage calculation alone.

units.0.notes.2.text: Cannot be Staggered before using Sundering and The Sphere. Do not assume Stagger can always skip a big attack.

units.1.notes.0.text: The encounter's first form. Direct skills and status effects do not reduce its HP.

units.1.notes.1.text: Clear Gondolas to reduce its special effect and advance to the humanoid form.

units.2.notes.0.text: 7 in total. Remaining Gondolas later return with their HP carried over even if they retreat midway.

units.2.notes.1.text: Defeating them with allied attacks rather than self-destruction also grants E.G.O resources.

units.3.notes.0.text: A special unit that restrains a Sinner. Overall and part HP are listed separately because the values differ. Check the targeted part's HP on screen.

units.3.notes.1.text: Has no separate Attack Skill table. Rescue, timeout, and boss-kill conditions are listed under passives.

units.4.notes.0.text: 4 horse-shaped units appear in the latter half. Supply Shield to the boss while present.

units.4.notes.1.text: When a Sinner defeats one, it becomes Memories of the Dreaming Adventure and supports allies. Has no separate Attack Skill table.

units.5.notes.0.text: A unit supporting the Sinners, not an enemy to defeat.

units.5.notes.1.text: Its buffs for allied Don Quixote change into Shield support for The Sphere.

units.6.notes.0.text: HP, resistances, and Speed are specific to this boss encounter, separate from regular-stage values.

units.6.notes.1.text: In addition to regular skills, uses an Unclashable self-destruct attack the turn after appearing. Stagger or kill it first.

phases.0.title.text: Destroy Gondolas and stop self-destruction before it acts

phases.0.steps.0.text: Bloodbags and Bloodfiends use an Unclashable self-destruct attack the turn after appearing. Stagger or kill them beforehand rather than trying to clash.

phases.0.steps.1.text: Clear Gondolas too, bringing The Endless Wheel to 0. Remaining units reappear later; do not confuse retreat with defeat.

phases.0.steps.2.text: “The Infinite Parade” and “The Eternal Festival” deal no damage to targets using Defense Skills. Equip Defense Skills in everyone's action slots before they arrive.

phases.0.steps.3.text: Few clashes make SP harder to build in this phase. Prepare SP recovery, desired E.G.O passives, and Identity mechanics here.

phases.1.title.text: Assign clashes around area-attack order and Bleed

phases.1.steps.0.text: As an opening guideline, clash with “Desire for Blood” → “Moment of Bloodfeast” → Hardblood Arts 14: Mantle. Account for “Moment of Bloodfeast” raising enemy SP and Bloodlust, then reduce Bloodlust by beating Mantle afterward.

phases.1.steps.1.text: Several “Hardblood Wedge” area attacks can appear with Unbreakable Coins. Check Speed order and all targets to avoid stacking them on heavily Bleeding Sinners.

phases.1.steps.2.text: Action order matters: act before gaining Bleed, or consume existing Count before taking another hit. If Bleed would kill a Sinner before their attack, use healing, defense, or reserves to recover.

phases.1.steps.3.text: The restraining Sloth version of Be Impaled has an Unbreakable second Coin. If hit, have allies quickly destroy the Spear. If an Identity can Evade, check its Evade Power and prediction too.

phases.2.title.text: Beat the big attack and make time for healing and Bleed management

phases.2.steps.0.text: Hardblood Arts 4 - Sundering gains Clash Power from cumulative Bloodfeast consumed. Win with a high-Power clasher to halve damage and prevent Stagger from this skill.

phases.2.steps.1.text: After use, enemy Offense and Defense Levels drop, and the Stagger at 73% HP is close. Stabilize allied HP and Bleed Count rather than rushing straight to the next boundary.

phases.2.steps.2.text: Around 60% HP, advance to the latter half. Save strong skills and actions for handling Dreams and the returning area attacks.

phases.3.timing.text: Latter humanoid phase / roughly 60% HP or below

phases.3.title.text: Have Sinners defeat all 4 Coagulated Dreams

phases.3.steps.0.text: “Bloody-Merry-Go-Round” is Unclashable. Use defense to endure it and prepare to handle the 4 Dreams that appear next turn.

phases.3.steps.1.text: Dreams supply Shield while alive. Rather than insisting on attacking the boss, have Sinners land the kills to transform Dreams into support Memories.

phases.3.steps.2.text: If the boss kills a Dream, the Sinners take Lust damage and heavy Bleed. Clear Dreams first with allies and secure the support needed.

phases.3.steps.3.text: Early in the latter half, if possible clash with “Hardblood Wedge” before “Moment of Bloodfeast”. This handles area attacks before the enemy gains more Bloodlust.

phases.4.title.text: Use Memories' support to survive the big attack, then damage the main body

phases.4.steps.0.text: Memories created by allied Dream kills convert their support into allied Shields on this big-attack turn. Finish handling Dreams before it arrives.

phases.4.steps.1.text: The Sphere has high Power and 2 Unbreakable Coins. Check that support is ready rather than repeatedly spending E.G.O solely on clash odds.

phases.4.steps.2.text: After use, all Bloodlust is consumed and the boss gains Fragile and Bind. Check remaining Spears and Bleed, then focus attacks on the main body to reach the ending event near 20%.

phases.5.title.text: Follow the prompts and use the special E.G.O

phases.5.steps.0.text: Other Sinners leaving and resources becoming 0 are part of the event. Do not mistake it for a normal team wipe.

phases.5.steps.1.text: Follow the prompts to use SUPERBIA from the Sapling of Light, then select Don Quixote's La Sangre de Sancho. Clash with the designated opponent even if the prediction is extremely unfavorable.

phases.5.steps.2.text: During the weapon-lock sequence, follow the on-screen button or Space-key prompts. You do not need a regular team capable of beating this 99 Power.

skills.0.effects.0.text: Unclashable. Damage −100% if the target uses a Defense Skill.

skills.0.response.text: Equip a Defense Skill to receive it. This is not a clash to answer with an Attack Skill against its predicted Power.

skills.1.effects.0.text: Unclashable. Damage −100% if the target uses a Defense Skill.

skills.1.response.text: Equip a Defense Skill to receive it. This is not a clash to answer with an Attack Skill against its predicted Power.

skills.2.effects.0.text: Uses an exploding skill next turn.

skills.2.response.text: Defeat it before the explosion. A defending enemy is not safe to ignore here.

skills.3.effects.1.text: Ⅰ：[After this Coin's attack] Deal 10 additional Lust damage to the target, then die.

skills.3.response.text: Aim to kill it before it acts. It is Unclashable; assigning an attack does not by itself stop it.

skills.4.effects.0.text: [On Use] Base Power +1 per 5 Bleed on the target (max 3). Consume up to 30 Bloodfeast; gain 1 Bloodlust per 10 consumed.

skills.4.response.text: Stronger against Bleeding allies. Avoid forcing weak clashes against a regular attack; save responses for the remaining area attacks and restraints.

skills.5.effects.0.text: [On Use] Consume up to 40 Bloodfeast; gain 1 Bloodlust and heal 3 SP per 10 consumed.

skills.5.effects.1.text: [Clash Lose] SP −3 and Bloodlust −3. Gain 3 Defense Level Down next turn.

skills.5.effects.2.text: Ⅰ・Ⅱ：[On Hit] Deal additional Lust damage equal to 20% of the target's max HP.

skills.5.response.text: Separate from the restraining Sloth version. Win to prevent the large percentage-based damage and reduce Bloodlust.

skills.6.effects.0.text: Targets the unit with the most Bleed. [On Use] Coin Power +1 per 5 Bleed on the target (max 2).

skills.6.effects.1.text: Ⅰ・Ⅱ：[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bleed and 2 Rupture.

skills.6.effects.2.text: Ⅲ：[On Hit] Deal additional Lust damage equal to the target's Bleed Potency × Count.

skills.6.response.text: Prevent heavy damage against allies with stacked Bleed. Reassess the target and clash prediction every turn.

skills.7.effects.0.text: [Combat Start] Attack Weight +1 per 3 Bloodlust (max 2). [After Attack] Consume 3 Bloodlust.

skills.7.effects.1.text: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Inflict 3 Bleed. [On Hit after Clash Win] Inflict 3 Rupture. [On Hit after Clash Lose] Consume 1 Bloodlust.

skills.7.effects.2.text: Ⅱ：[On Hit] Bleed Count +2. [On Hit after Clash Win] Inflict 3 Rupture. [On Hit after Clash Lose] Consume 1 Bloodlust.

skills.7.response.text: The first 2 Coins of the area attack remain. Winning prevents Coin III and additional effects while reducing Bloodlust. Check additional targets to avoid stacking attacks on Bleeding Sinners.

skills.8.effects.0.text: [On Use] Consume up to 40 Bloodfeast; gain 1 Bloodlust and heal 5 SP per 10 consumed.

skills.8.effects.1.text: Ⅰ・Ⅱ・Ⅲ：[On Hit] Increase Bleed Count by 1.

skills.8.response.text: Do not apply the Mirror Dungeon-only 80% damage reduction on Clash Lose to the story version. Consider clashing before “Moment of Bloodfeast”, then managing Bleed Count through later actions.

skills.9.effects.1.text: [On Use] Consume up to 300 Bloodfeast; gain 1 Bloodlust and heal 3 SP per 10 consumed. If Bloodfeast was consumed, heal another 30 SP.

skills.9.response.text: Rapidly strengthens the enemy. Plan the order with other skills: after “Desire for Blood” but before Mantle in the opening, or after Wedge early in the latter half.

skills.10.effects.0.text: Cannot become Staggered until this skill is used.

skills.10.effects.1.text: [On Use] Consume up to 100 Bloodfeast; gain 1 Bloodlust and heal 15 SP per 10 consumed. Clash Power +1 per 30 Bloodfeast consumed cumulatively (max 15).

skills.10.effects.2.text: [Clash Lose] Halve damage; targets cannot be Staggered by this skill's damage.

skills.10.effects.3.text: [After Attack] Gain Offense and Defense Level Down this turn and next turn equal to the Clash Power gained (max 15).

skills.10.effects.4.text: Ⅰ：[On Hit] Inflict 8 Bleed and consume 2 Bloodlust.

skills.10.response.text: Conditional bonuses can exceed the listed Power. Win to reduce damage, then use the post-attack weakness to manage Bleed and recover too.

skills.11.effects.1.text: [Clash Win] Inflict 4 Bleed and 4 Rupture on the target. [Clash Lose] Consume 2 Bloodlust.

skills.11.response.text: Win to reduce Bloodlust. Do not leave it unchecked as if it were a normal Guard.

skills.12.effects.0.text: Base Power +1 per 10 Bloodlust. Coin Power +1 per 5 Bleed on the target (max 2).

skills.12.effects.2.text: Ⅰ・Ⅱ：[On Hit] Inflict 2 Bleed and increase Bleed Count by 2.

skills.12.response.text: A negative-Coin Counter. Low enemy SP does not necessarily weaken it. Do not force a dangerous clash on a Bleeding main combatant.

skills.13.effects.0.text: Unclashable. [On Use] Create Coagulated Dreams next turn.

skills.13.response.text: Used at the transition into the latter half. Use defense to receive it, then prepare for allies to defeat the 4 Dreams.

skills.14.effects.1.text: Ⅱ：[On Hit] Stagger the target and inflict Congealing Blood next turn. [After this Coin's attack] Remove up to 25 Bleed Potency from the target; gain that amount on self and increase Bloodfeast by it.

skills.14.response.text: Coin II restrains the target and remains after a clash win. Choose an Evade or a Sinner to receive it, then have allies quickly destroy the generated Spear to free them.

skills.15.name.text: Ascendant Don Quixote Hardblood Arts - The Sphere

skills.15.effects.0.text: Cannot become Staggered before use. Damage increases by shared cumulative Bloodfeast consumed as a percentage (max 300%).

skills.15.effects.1.text: [On Use] Heal 30 SP. Clash Power +1 per 10 Bloodlust.

skills.15.effects.2.text: [After Attack] Consume all Bloodlust. Gain 5 Fragile this turn and next turn, and 2 Bind next turn.

skills.15.response.text: Prepare Shields through Memories created by Sinner Dream kills. The boss becomes much weaker after use; finish from that opening.

skills.16.name.text: Ascendant Don Quixote Hardblood Arts - La Sangre

skills.16.effects.0.text: A special skill readied for the ending event. You do not need to overpower it in a normal Power contest.

skills.16.response.text: Follow the prompts to select allied Don Quixote's designated E.G.O through SUPERBIA, then clash with this skill to advance the sequence.

skills.17.effects.0.text: [Combat Start] Grant 1 Clash Power Up and 1 Damage Up to 1 random Sinner. Inflict 1 Fragile on the boss and Coagulated Dreams.

skills.17.response.text: An allied support skill. You do not need to attack the transformed Memories.

mechanics.0.effect.text: Starts at 7; decreases by 1 per Gondola defeated. At 0 with no pending summons, changes to the humanoid form.

mechanics.0.response.text: Use remaining Gondolas rather than Ferris Wheel HP to track progression.

mechanics.1.effect.text: Gained by consuming Bloodfeast. Reaches II at 10 or more and III at 20 or more. Stage II grants Offense and Defense Level Up and +1 Clash Power; III adds effects including +1 Coin Power. Bleed and Rupture application also increases.

mechanics.1.response.text: Stop Mantle, Wedge, and other skills that reduce Bloodlust on your clash win, limiting later area-attack damage.

mechanics.2.effect.text: Incapacitated for 2 turns; creates a corresponding Spear.

mechanics.2.response.text: Assign a Spear clearer to prevent timeout damage and boss kills.

mechanics.3.effect.text: Created from Dreams defeated by Sinners. Restores SP and buffs allied Don Quixote; supplies Shields to everyone for The Sphere.

mechanics.3.response.text: Have Sinners, not the boss, defeat Dreams and turn them into support before the big attack.

mechanics.4.effect.text: HP cannot fall below 1 while another Sinner is alive. Base E.G.O cannot be used during normal combat. Gains Offense Level and SP-related buffs as turns pass and under other conditions. The Manager Identity's special effects differ.

mechanics.4.response.text: Can receive attacks alone, but cannot protect the whole team from area damage. Keep another Sinner alive.

warnings.0.text: Be Impaled has a Wrath version with percentage-based damage and a Sloth version with restraints. Distinguish them by affinity and effects.

warnings.1.text: Do not apply the Mirror Dungeon-only 80% damage reduction on Clash Lose to the story version's big attacks.

warnings.2.text: HP boundaries can end the turn. Do not calculate resources and damage assuming every skill will act.

warnings.3.text: Dream support Shields are important preparation for the big attack. Stagger near a boundary can shift activation timing; check actual Shields and the displayed big attack.

warnings.4.text: Departing Sinners and 0 resources in the ending sequence are part of the mechanic. Proceed with the prompted E.G.O and controls.

preparation.0.text: Aim for the recommended Lv.50 on main combatants and reserves. A Chain Battle with 6 deployed Sinners and 6 reserves; Don Quixote is mandatory.

preparation.1.text: Prepare SP and HP recovery, Protection, and Shields. Check E.G.O resources gathered in the dungeon too.

preparation.2.text: Prepare for Pierce and Blunt area attacks and Bleed. Clash strength alone is insufficient; remaining Coins also require resistances and HP.

preparation.3.text: Starting SP modifiers for reserves have opposite signs for positive- and negative-Coin Identities. Decide who enters after a casualty.

roles.0.name.text: Main combatants who clash while managing Bleed

roles.0.reason.text: Beat area attacks and Mantle to reduce Bloodlust. Check attack order and additional targets too.

roles.1.reason.text: Handle rescues, stop Shield generation, and create support rather than focusing only on the main body.

roles.2.reason.text: A long encounter where not every hit can be prevented. Survive the difficult humanoid opening and advance to the later mechanics.

messages.リンバス(Limbus Company)7-36「ドンキホーテ（7章最終ボス）」: Don Quixote (Canto VII Final Boss) guide for Limbus Company 7-36. A long encounter: clear adds during the Ferris Wheel phase, then manage Bleed and restraints in the humanoid phase. Have allies defeat Coagulated Dreams to turn them into support and prepare for the big attacks.
